Warm Spray.name: Warm Spray
Warm Spray.description: The user fires a steaming stream of hot water from the palm out to five meters, half a pure Water user's range. It puts out small fires, settles dust and smoke, or hits a target for bludgeoning damage that knocks them back a step; held back, it cools to a warm splash in the face that spoils their aim until the end of their next turn. Each stream drains the user's water reserves. Strain: light.
